description: Allows WinUI design help or a working control example to correct an invalid layout approach.
prompt: Foxglove Queue rejects ListView.HeaderTemplateSelector. What's the WinUI 3 layout for a filter row that stays put above scrolling results? An example would help; it needs to work at 200% text size.

paraphrases.novice: I can't get Foxglove Queue's filter box to stay above the list while it scrolls. The property I tried isn't accepted. Can you show how to arrange this WinUI 3 screen so it also works with larger text?
paraphrases.terse: Foxglove: HeaderTemplateSelector rejected. Fixed filter above scrolling WinUI list, 200% text.
